name: Ultimate Dating Sim
source:
After every 300 years, a new alchemist is brought into the world to fight the dark forces of the primordial being Erebus.

But this time, one of his emissaries escape the seal and curses the alchemist; with the only way of breaking the curse being a true love's kiss... from another man.

You play as Samson, a white male lion in the land of Tenebrae in a realm set in Greek mythology, where queer identities have long been deemed illegal and taboo.

Journeying throughout the land of Tenebrae, solve puzzles and obtain clues to find your way to break the curse. 

[From [url=https://hugecookie.itch.io/ultimate-dating-sim]Itch.io[/url]]
